Perfect for tying during Rakhi ceremonies, the thread symbolises protection and love, while the Roli and Akshat enhance blessings with their spiritual significance. Designed for meaningful experiences, this combo ensures your festivities are steeped in tradition. Ideal for Hindu households, it brings an auspicious touch to your sacred ceremonies, fostering a deeper connection with your loved ones.

Puja Supari, also known as Betel Nut, holds significant importance in Hindu rituals, particularly during Gauri Ganesha Puja. Originating from the Mangal Bhawan brand, this supari is crafted from high-quality fruit material, designed in a pristine oval shape and white colour, embodying purity and devotion. Each piece measures 15 x 10 x 10 mm, making it ideal for ceremonial use. Packaged in a set of five, these betel nuts symbolise prosperity and are integral in offerings to Lord Ganesha. Perfectly suited for auspicious occasions, Puja Supari enhances the sanctity and completeness of traditional worship practices.

Water from the river Ganga has great spiritual significance to all Hindus. No pooja is complete without the use of this holy water. Make your Pooja complete with Mangalbhavan Ganga Jal, sourced from Brahma Kund in Haridwar.

Mangal Bhavan herbal and natural Holi/Gulal is made from corn starch. All-natural ingredients are used in all the products. This year stay safe and say no to harmful chemicals that wreak havoc on your skin and hair. It comes in exciting and vibrant colour options like red, yellow, pink, green and orange. These are eco-friendly, you can splash around as much colour as you want without suffering any sort of guilt.
details.usageInstructions: It is applied on each other faces on the occasion of Holi.
